Wilson, E. J., Johnson, T. L., & Keith, D. W. (2003). Regulating the ultimate sink: Managing the risks of geologic CO2 storage. Environmental Science & Technology, 37(16), 3476-3483. https://doi.org/10.1021/es021038+

NO TECHNOLOGY PARAMETERS EXTRACTED. A regulatory review of US underground injection control (UIC) experience and its implications for geologic CO2 storage: risk categories, liability and regulatory design. It reports no capture, transport or storage costs, energy use or plant characteristics. Relevant as background for the storage side of CCS, which the database does not cost.
